name: Spine Corrector Series
description: A suite of exercises on the spine corrector barrel that combines spinal articulation, hip opening, and shoulder mobilization for postural rebalancing.

benefits: Corrects postural imbalances, opens the chest, and develops segmental spinal control.

safetyNote: Confirm the apparatus setup and use smooth breath-driven control; stop if any joint or neck discomfort appears.
